AND EXISTS( select 1 from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL where (DEAL.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID or deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID )
and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )
)

/*待处理*/ SELECT * FROM ( select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, listagg(t8.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by t8.CASH_TYPE) cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,
t8.SEC_ACCT_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
min(t9.VDATE) vdateProd, t8.MDATE mdateProd, null tradeDate, t8.qty remainPrinAmt, SUM(t8.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, null TRADE_AMT, t8.PAY_DATE adjustDate, null workflowId, null pTradeId from ( select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, sum(t7.QTY) qty, sum(t7.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ sum(nvl(t7.prinAmt,0)) prinAmt,/*还本金额*/ sum(t7.intAmt) intAmt,/*理论利息*/
t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T1.CASH_TYPE, T1.CASH_ID, T1.MDATE, T1.CDATE, double(T1.CASH_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ case T1.CASH_TYPE when '${CASH_CLASS_TYPE01}' then 0 else double(T1.PRIN_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt,/*还本金额*/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, double(T1.INT_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) intAmt,/*理论利息*/ T1.PAY_DATE FROM ( select * from ( SELECT T1.AMOUNT, t1.finprod_id, t1.sec_acct_id, t1.cdate, t6.cash_type, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T6.CASH_BASEAMT, T1.FACE_VALUE, T6.PRIN_AMT, T6.INT_AMT, T6.PAY_DATE, rank() over(partition by t6.finprod_id order by t6.mdate) rank from PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id=t6.finprod_id INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and tfpdt.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND t1.finprod_id=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID and T6.MDATE = tfpdt.MDATE ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.WORKFLOW_STATUS = #{STATUS_A} AND T1.FINPROD_ID=TFPDT.FINPROD_ID AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID and T6.MDATE >= tfpdt.MDATE )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < T6.MDATE ) and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' and T6.MDATE >= #{PLATEFORM_DATE}
and T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND T1.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07} and T1.AMOUNT > 0 where T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
) where rank = 1 ) T1) T7 group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE ) T8
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON TC4.FINPROD_ID = T8.SEC_ACCT_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID
AND t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
AND t8.CASH_TYPE = #{cashTypeC}
AND t8.MDATE >= to_date(#{mdateProdStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND t8.MDATE <= to_date(#{mdateProdEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND t8.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
GROUP BY
t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME,
t8.SEC_ACCT_ID, TC4.FINPROD_NAME,
t8.MDATE, t8.qty, t8.PAY_DATE, fprod_type.TYPE_6 ORDER BY T8.MDATE )
UNION ALL
/*有效数据*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS05}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PS cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,

and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )

fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,

FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, NULL channelFee, sum(t8.fpriceAmt) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN (t8.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL OR t8.SEC_ACCT_ID='999999') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END channel,

fccrt_2.YIELD*100 loadRate,
fccr.YIELD*100 yield,
null feeAmt,

sum(t8.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, sum(t8.fpriceAmt) tradeAmt,
sum(t8.prinAmt) prinAmtTheory, sum(t8.intAmt) intAmt, sum(t8.intAmt) theoryInt,

t7.SEC_ACCT_ID,
sum(t7.QTY) qty, sum(t7.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ sum(nvl(t7.prinAmt,0)) prinAmt,/*还本金额*/ sum(t7.intAmt) intAmt,/*理论利息*/
t7.PAY_DATE from tmpTable T7 WHERE T7.CDATE in (SELECT MAX(CDATE) FROM tmpTable group by CASH_ID,MDATE,sec_acct_id)

t8.SEC_ACCT_ID, TC10.FINPROD_NAME,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE, CASE WHEN (t8.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL OR t8.SEC_ACCT_ID='999999') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
t8.MDATE, t10.VDATE, t10.MDATE, t10.ENTRUSTER, fccr.YIELD, fccrt_2.YIELD, t8.PAY_DATE, fccr.BASIS ORDER BY T8.MDATE
